# Camilo Flores

> Web developer building fast, accessible websites — by hand. Focus: performance & accessibility. Stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript. Based in Chile, open to remote roles worldwide.

## About

Camilo builds close to the platform: native CSS before animation libraries, semantic HTML before ARIA patches, measured performance instead of assumed performance. He currently works full-time as a web developer at a Chilean technology company with international presence.

## Selected work

- camiloflores.cl — Sales site for a local web-dev practice. No UI framework, no client JS beyond a live load-time meter; the speed is the argument. https://www.camiloflores.cl/
- Encuentro PyME Aconcagua — Demo event landing with a real registration form that works with no client JS (Cloudflare Worker + Resend, native POST). https://landingdemo1.houdini-dev.workers.dev/
- GVE Sistemas — Client website, built end-to-end. No longer online; presented with a client testimonial.
